title: Press coverage: PS5X boots four non-exclusive PS5 titles in Developer Mode
summary: Multiple outlets report that PS5X has booted Quake II, GEX Trilogy, Hellboy: Web of Wyrd and Marvel Cosmic Invasion on Xbox Series X, with Astro Bot running near 10 FPS. No public download has been released.

title: PS5X proof-of-concept demo boots Quake II on Xbox Series X
summary: Developer Devran Cosmo Uenal demonstrates a port of the open-source KytyPS5 emulator running the PS5 version of Quake II in Xbox Developer Mode, played with an Xbox controller.
